requirement: Goals: measured when the target moves, bound to its tree; a server head live on the test server unblocks the client
check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_hd.R1 && python3 hd.py | grep -E '^goal .* tree [0-9a-f]{7,}'

requirement: Flow: defined to live with no person once deps are live; a change the user closes takes no step; a done or closed change leaves no worktree or local branch; the orchestrator session spawns every run and is the user's chat; the user types the yes and the close
Contract: rows before code, every row judged once, verdicts append, text fixed in place; gate bound to T, verdict and approval to head and contract
check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_hd.R3 && for f in evidence/*/contract.md; do grep -qE '^- [a-z0-9-]+ \|' "$f" || exit 1; done

requirement: Authority: only the carry writes to OpenRune or releases, only at the head and texts the user approved on the queue PR
Recovery: any failure repaired in one pass; repairs logged on observed effect; the user raised once per change
Economy: script before agent before user; nothing checked twice per input; agent count; events on edges; hand-off at the context limit; a desktop up only while played; bring-up as a script
check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_hd.R6 && ~/src/OpenRune-Server/.worktrees/harness/tools/track.sh up ${SLUG:?} 2 | grep -c LOGGED_IN | grep -qx 2

requirement: Visibility: hd prints spawns, cards, questions, runs, goals and change facts, nothing else, no step names as states

Trees: T by merge-tree; a merge ref for a resolution against a permanent pin; built once in a copy no agent commits from; cache by input hash; artefacts named by slug or run; a game client is a mobile or a desktop
check: python3 -m unittest tests.test_hd.R8 && ~/src/OpenRune-Server/.worktrees/harness/tools/track.sh build ${SLUG:?} >/dev/null && ~/src/OpenRune-Server/.worktrees/harness/tools/track.sh build ${SLUG:?} | grep -q cached
